title: Athens in 4 Days: Practical Itinerary with Food & Local Insights (2026)
introduction: Athens is more than ancient ruins. This 4-day itinerary balances history, neighborhoods, and local experiences for a complete trip.

sections.heading: Day 1: Acropolis & History
sections.content: Start early and explore Acropolis, Parthenon, and the Acropolis Museum. Walk through Plaka in the evening.

sections.heading: Day 3: Museums & Culture
sections.content: Visit National Archaeological Museum and Benaki Museum.

sections.heading: Day 4: Relax & Views
sections.content: Visit Lycabettus Hill and enjoy café culture.

seo.meta_description: Plan your Athens trip with this practical 4-day itinerary.

faqs.question: Is 4 days enough?
faqs.answer: Yes, it covers major highlights comfortably.
